notes: Two new home-screen widget families, powered by your exam and timetable tags separately: EXAMS — Countdown (big days-left number), Next exam (next or in-progress, with time remaining and progress bar), My exams (your personal upcoming list); SEMESTER — Next milestone countdown, live semester Timeline with a today marker and S1/S2/finals dots, and a Month calendar with your exam days marked. All widgets refresh on unlock, on tap of the refresh icon, and in the background. Find them in the widget picker under Exams · and Semester · (existing one is now Timetable · Next Class).
